sources.used: physical/executed layers, looped span, hidden 1280 → 1056, experts 192 → 288, top-8
rows Baseline,200M,24 and SMELT,200M,24: heads, KV heads, head dim, expert FFN width, parameters per expert
Sec. 3.2: FLOPs 1.33e9 → 1.37e9 (+2.9%), params 3.87e9 → 3.89e9 (+0.4%), KV within 4%; tab:matching tolerances

formulas.params: per layer: attention H·d_head·(2·n_q + 2·n_kv) + router H·E + E experts × 3·H·d_ffn (SwiGLU); × 12 physical layers. Norm weights omitted (< 0.01%). Reproduces 3.87B and 3.89B.
formulas.flops: F ≈ 6 · (active non-embedding params per executed layer) · L_exec + k · n_q·d_head · L_exec. The second term is the attention-score cost that grows with document length; its single coefficient k is calibrated so the Baseline gives 1.33e9. The same k then gives 1.0290× for SMELT (paper: 1.029×), and the matmul part is exact config arithmetic.
formulas.kv: KV entries per token = 2 · n_kv · d_head · L_exec (each visit of a looped layer keeps its own cache: share_kv_cache = false in the SMELT config). Reproduces the appendix ratio 1.031.

notes: Steps loop, narrow and experts are hypothetical intermediate configurations used to teach the recipe; only Baseline and SMELT were trained. In the paper all knobs are solved jointly.
Intermediate FLOPs ratios are approximate (they inherit the calibrated attention term); parameter and KV ratios are config arithmetic.

Narrow shrinks every width that scales with H: hidden 1280 → 1056, expert FFN 432 → 352 and the query projection 10 → 8 heads at head dim 128 (query width 1024 ≈ H; n_q·d_head = H holds in every row of raw_data/conf/index.csv, and 8 is the closest whole number of heads that keeps head dim and KV heads fixed). KV cache is therefore unchanged by this step.
The attention step changes head dim 128 → 88 and query heads 8 → 12 (KV heads stay 2; GQA 4:1 → 6:1), reaching the trained SMELT configuration (12 · 88 = 1056 = H).
So each step restores one budget, in the order of the article and paper Sec. 3.2: narrow → FLOPs, experts → total parameters, attention → KV cache.
